newsitem.title: USA: US West Media ,Airtouch merge wireless.
newsitem.headline: US West Media ,Airtouch merge wireless.

text.p: U S WEST Media Group said it would merge its domestic cellular business NewVector and its interest in PrimeCo Personal Communications into AirTouch Communications in a deal valued at about $5 billion.

As a result of the deal, AirTouch said it would obtain ownership of Media Group's domestic wireless business. The transaction included AirTouch's assumption of $2.2 billion of debt and the distribution of AirTouch stock to Media Group shareholders tax-free, the companies said.

AirTouch said it expected to add to its proportionate U.S. cellular and PCS portfolio up to about 34 million POPs, 1.9 million customers and $300 million operating cash flow, based on pro-forma 1996 results.
This would bring its worldwide proportionate totals to 212 million POPS, 10 million customers and $1.4 billion operating cash flow, the company said.
U S Media Group's overseas wireless properties were not affected, it said.
